name: Jemimah
background: A young woman who sells fragrant spices and flowers near the Temple courtyard. She observes much from her flower stall.

dialogue.neutral: Fresh myrtle for the Passover! The lamb must be robed in fragrant herbs!
dialogue.cautious: I don't involve myself in these matters. I'm just a flower seller.
dialogue.pressured: I heard the crowd moving through the garden late at night.
dialogue.exposed: They came with torches and ropes! And one young man ran off in only his skin!

genericReactions.physical: Hmm. I'm not sure how that connects to me.
genericReactions.testimonial: That's not what I said at all.
genericReactions.digital: I don't know anything about that information.
genericReactions.analytical: Numbers can be misleading, you know.
genericReactions.prophecy: A prophecy fulfilled? I see the connection now.
